lines.text: The root is Gress! Progress, aggressive.
Did you know? Gress is Latin for step.
Quick quiz! Which means toward plus step?

words.ex: You have made great progress with your writing.
The dog next door is quite aggressive.

publish.title: Gress root: progress and aggressive
publish.value: Gress comes from Latin "gradi" (to step, to walk). Words: progress and aggressive. progress = pro + gress; aggressive = ag + gress.
